checkpoint_review: The Router's checkpoint verdicts are mostly reasonable but show leniency on the tail checkpoint. The 'Tail is laterally compressed and longer than body' was marked untestable, but the tail base is visible and shows lateral compression, so partial verification was possible. The limb checkpoint was correctly marked present based on the one visible front limb, though the Router should have noted only partial limb visibility. Other checkpoints align well with visible features. The Router was appropriately critical on most checkpoints but too dismissive on the tail verification.
artifact_review: The Router identified three artifacts but underestimated the limb structural issues. The animal_pose_auditor reveals HIGH artifact risk with 59% low-confidence keypoints concentrated in front/hind limbs, indicating more severe structural uncertainty than the Router's severity 2.0 rating for digit fusion. This should be elevated to 3.0-3.5. The dewlap texture anomaly (1.5) and background perspective distortion (1.0) are appropriately rated. The topology_boundary_auditor's high mask confidence (0.9764) confirms boundary coherence but doesn't contradict internal structural defects. The perceptual_quality_auditor's null finding is expected as it doesn't detect anatomical artifacts.
alignment_reasoning: 8/9 checkpoints testable with all passing. Fine-grained classifier strongly confirms class (logit 7.71). Router was too lenient on tail checkpoint which had partial visibility. Limb structural uncertainty from pose auditor indicates anatomical inaccuracies affecting alignment. Score reduced from base 4.72 due to partial tail verification failure and limb anatomy concerns.
